page: Amazon Web Services x8aedz.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, memory-optimized server powered by an AMD x86_64 architecture. The system provides 96 physical cores and 96 vCPUs with a single thread per core, operating at clock speeds of up to 5.0 GHz. Designed for extreme memory requirements, the machine is configured with 3072.0 GB of system RAM, yielding an allocation of 32.0 GB of memory per core.

Integrated local storage is supplied via 7600 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, providing direct disk access without virtualization layers. Networking capability includes a 75 Gbps baseline bandwidth connection. The server does not contain dedicated graphics processing units and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Because the configuration provides dedicated bare-metal access to hardware, it avoids hypervisor overhead and virtualization jitter across CPU and memory controllers. From a resource perspective, the high ratio of 32.0 GB RAM per core coupled with high single-thread clock frequencies allows organizations to consolidate large distributed footprints into a single hardware footprint, lowering inter-node communication latency.

The x8aedz.metal-24xl is suited for large-scale enterprise workloads that demand substantial memory tables and fast local disks, including massive in-memory databases, large Redis and Memcached clusters, real-time analytics engines, and transactional relational database systems.
